name: services/mailing/send_simple_message
description:
Send an email message, to any given email address(es).
	USOS API will automatically set all headers, apply word-wrap and append
	USOS signature and/or comments.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.description: Subject of the message (no more than 200 characters).

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Content of the message (no more than 15000 characters).

arguments.name: recipients
arguments.description: Pipe-separated list of email addresses - recipients of the message.

arguments.name: from_name
arguments.description: Name to be inserted into the From header (no more than 100 characters).

arguments.name: content_format
arguments.description:
Type of content argument. Valid ones:

  • plain - plain text (MIME text/plain)

    USOS API will apply word-wrap.

  • html - text with HTML markup (MIME text/html)

    USOS API will try to repair broken HTML. Some elements ( scripts, embedded objects, frames, forms) will be removed due to security reasons.

arguments.name: from_email
arguments.description: Email to be inserted into the From header (no more than 100 characters). Valid only is passed along the from_name argument. If not given, this will be a default no-reply address.

arguments.name: send_summary_to
arguments.description:
Email address. If given, USOS API will send a summary report to this address.
	This report will contain any errors USOS API encountered while
	sending the message. Original message content and recipients might be included.
	These reports might be split in several parts.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Either pl or en - the language, in which USOS API will generate headers and signatures that might be added to your message prior to the sending. This will also be the language in which the optional summary report will be generated.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
The method returns a dictionary of the following structure:

  • success - currently always true ( if something goes wrong, you will get a HTTP 400 error),

  • message_id - an unique message ID generated for your message.

    Message IDs might be used to check the status of the message. Please note, that messages are kept for a period of 7 days. After this time, you won't be able to reference your message.
